summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a distance voting ballot for its Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 28, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice and procedural document providing instructions for shareholders to vote remotely, including deadlines and voting procedures. No special-situation transaction (merger, acquisition, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is a standard corporate governance communication, not a special situation event.
